title: Naive indexOf Offset 0 Matching
root_cause: Inline indexOf searched from 0 without monotonic tracking causing first-occurrence collision
resolution_or_mitigation: Replaced with alignment.ts sequential monotonic cursor tracking

title: Document Swallowing on Next-Clause Miss
root_cause: Defaulted endPos to raw.length if next clause prefix not found
resolution_or_mitigation: Replaced with verified boundary gate requiring proven adjacent start index

title: Indiscriminate Literal Ellipsis Stripping
root_cause: Regex stripped trailing dots even from literal ellipsis in substantive legal text
resolution_or_mitigation: Updated extractSearchToken to require preview length >= 100 before stripping

title: CRLF vs LF Linebreak Desynchronization
root_cause: FastAPI normalized to LF while Windows clients upload CRLF causing verbatim mismatch
resolution_or_mitigation: Implemented findOccurrencesForToken adapting newlines dynamically without offset drift

title: Missing Preview-Only Status Badge
root_cause: Unverified clauses did not indicate why full text was unavailable
resolution_or_mitigation: Added accessible status badge 'Preview only — full clause boundary could not be verified'

title: Backend Source Offsets Not Serialized
root_cause: ClauseScoringResultModel does not expose char_start/char_end over HTTP
resolution_or_mitigation: Mitigated via frontend alignment engine with safe fallback to preview

title: Repeated Non-Unique Headings Ambiguity
root_cause: Identical repeated headings produce identical previews without sequence numbers
resolution_or_mitigation: Safely handled by falling back to PREVIEW_ONLY_AMBIGUOUS for repeated headings
